name: Air Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front for balance.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are level with the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up tall.

name: Jump Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and squat down to about half depth.
Swing your arms up and jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell or kettlebell upright against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet a little wider than your shoulders, toes turned out slightly.
Squat down between your knees, keeping your chest up.
Stand back up by pressing through your heels.

name: Barbell Squat
steps: Rest the bar on your upper back and step out of the rack.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Lower yourself until your thighs are at least level with the floor.
Push up through your whole foot, keeping your chest up and back flat.

name: Pistol Squat
steps: Stand on one leg with the other leg held straight out in front.
Reach your arms forward and slowly squat down on the standing leg.
Go as low as you can control, then push back up to standing.
Hold a post for balance until you are strong enough to go without.

name: Front Squat
steps: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high.
Step back from the rack and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, keeping your chest up and elbows pointing forward.
Push through your feet to stand back up.

name: Hack Squat
steps: Stand on the platform with your back on the pad, shoulders under the pads.
With feet shoulder-width apart, release the safety handles.
Lower yourself until your thighs are level with the foot platform.
Push through your feet to rise, without snapping your knees straight.

name: Reverse Hack Squat
steps: Stand facing the pad of a hack squat machine, shoulders under the pads.
Release the safety handles and push your hips back as you bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are level with the platform.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and unhook it by turning your wrists.
Walk your feet a little in front of the bar, shoulder-width apart.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor.
Push up through your feet, and hook the bar back when you finish.

name: Box Squat
steps: Set a box behind you and rest the bar on your upper back.
Sit your hips back and squat down until you lightly touch the box.
Stay tight without relaxing on the box, then push up to standing.

name: Pause Squat
steps: Rest the bar on your upper back and step out of the rack.
Squat until your hips sit level with your knees or lower.
Hold still at the bottom for two seconds, staying tight.
Push up through your whole foot to stand tall.

name: Dumbbell Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell at each side, feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and squat until your thighs are level with the floor.
Keep your chest up and push through your heels to stand.

name: Sumo Squat
steps: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, holding one dumbbell between your legs.
Bend your knees and lower straight down, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Push through your heels and squeeze your inner thighs to stand back up.

name: Barbell Sumo Squat
steps: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet wide, toes out.
Squat straight down, pushing your knees out in line with your toes.
Stop when your thighs are level with the floor, then stand back up.

name: Overhead Squat
steps: Hold the bar overhead with a wide grip and your arms locked straight.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Squat down, keeping the bar over the middle of your feet.
Stand back up with arms straight; learn it with an empty bar first.

name: Sissy Squat
steps: Hold a post with one hand and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Lean back as your knees travel forward, hips and shoulders in line.
Lower as far as is comfortable, then push back up using your thighs.

name: Weighted Sissy Squat
steps: Hug a plate to your chest and hold a post with your free hand.
Rise onto the balls of your feet and lean back slightly.
Push your knees forward to lower, keeping knees, hips and shoulders in line.
Push back up using your thighs.

name: Belt Squat
steps: Clip the belt around your hips and stand on the platform, feet shoulder-width.
Hold the handles lightly and release the safety lever.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor, then stand back up.

name: Landmine Squat
steps: Hold the free end of a landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand facing the bar, feet shoulder-width apart, leaning slightly into it.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor.
Stand back up by pressing through your heels.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
steps: Take a long step forward with a dumbbell at each side.
Lower your back knee straight down until it almost touches the floor.
Push through your front foot to rise, keeping both feet in place.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch legs.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Rest one foot on a bench behind you, a dumbbell in each hand.
Stand far enough forward that your front heel stays down.
Lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping your chest up.
Push through your front heel to rise; switch legs after your set.

name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: With the bar on your back, rest one foot on a bench behind you.
Lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping your chest up.
Push through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Smith Machine Split Squat
steps: Unhook the bar on your upper back with one foot forward and one back.
Drop your back knee straight down, stopping just above the floor.
Push through your front foot to rise; switch legs after your set.

name: Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall, holding a dumbbell at each side.
Take a long step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push off and bring your back foot through into the next step.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
steps: Stand tall, holding a dumbbell at each side.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push off your front foot to step back, then switch legs.

name: Barbell Lunge
steps: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push off your front foot to step back, then switch legs.

name: Bodyweight Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push off your front foot to step back, then switch legs.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall, holding a dumbbell at each side.
Step one foot back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through your front heel to bring your back foot forward again.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive off your front heel to return, then switch legs.

name: Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand with feet together and hands clasped at your chest.
Step wide to one side and sit your hips back over that foot.
Keep the other leg straight, then push off to return and switch sides.

name: Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand tall, holding a dumbbell at each side.
Step one foot behind and across the other, like a curtsy.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, chest up.
Drive off your front heel to return, then switch legs.

name: Jumping Lunge
steps: Start in a lunge with one foot forward and both knees bent.
Jump up and switch legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other foot forward and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
steps: Face a sturdy bench or box, holding a dumbbell at each side.
Place one foot fully on the box and push through it to stand up.
Step down slowly with the same leg; switch legs after your set.

name: Barbell Step-Up
steps: Rest the bar on your upper back and face a sturdy box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box and push through it to stand up.
Step down slowly with the same leg; switch legs after your set.

name: Leg Press
steps: Sit back in the seat and set your feet shoulder-width on the plate.
Push the plate up slightly and release the safety handles.
Lower the plate until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press back up through your heels without locking your knees.

name: Single-Leg Leg Press
steps: Sit in the leg press with one foot in the middle of the plate.
Release the safety handles and lower the plate under control.
Press back up through your heel; switch legs after your set.

name: Seated Leg Press
steps: Sit back against the pad, feet flat on the plate.
Hold the handles and press until your legs are almost straight.
Bend your knees slowly to bring the weight back.

name: Leg Extension
steps: Sit with your back on the pad and the roller just above your ankles.
Hold the handles and straighten your legs to lift the pad.
Squeeze your thighs at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
steps: Sit on the leg extension machine with the roller above one ankle.
Straighten that leg to lift the pad, squeezing your thigh at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie on your front on the machine, roller resting just above your heels.
Keep your hips on the pad and curl your heels towards your hips.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly without letting the weights touch.

name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Sit with the roller under your lower calves and the thigh pad locked down.
Curl your heels down and back under the seat as far as you can.
Return slowly until your legs are almost straight.

name: Standing Leg Curl
steps: Stand at the machine with the roller behind one ankle, holding the handles.
Curl your heel up towards your hip, keeping your thigh still.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

name: Dumbbell Leg Curl
steps: Lie on your front along a bench, knees just past the end.
Grip a light dumbbell firmly between your feet.
Curl your heels towards your hips, then lower slowly.

name: Nordic Curl
steps: Kneel on a mat with your heels held down by a pad or partner.
Keep your body straight from knees to head and lean forward slowly.
Lower under control, then catch yourself with your hands.
Push off lightly and pull yourself back up with the back of your thighs.

name: Swiss Ball Leg Curl
steps: Lie on your back with heels on a gym ball, arms at your sides.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Pull the ball towards you with your heels, then roll it back out.

name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall holding the bar at your thighs, hands just outside your legs.
Knees slightly bent, push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Stop at a strong stretch behind your thighs, keeping your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward to stand up.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with the dumbbells resting against the front of your thighs.
Knees slightly bent, push your hips back and lower the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop at a strong stretch behind your thighs, keeping your back flat.
Push your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Lean forward from the hips as your free leg rises straight behind you.
Lower until your body is nearly level with the floor, back flat.
Push your hips forward to stand up; switch sides after your set.

name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with feet wider than your hips, kettlebell on the floor in front.
Push your hips behind you as the bell swings between your legs, back flat.
Snap your hips forward to swing the bell up to chest height.
Let it swing back between your legs and go into the next rep.

name: Cable Pull-Through
steps: Clip a rope to a low pulley and face away, rope between your legs.
Walk out a few steps, feet a little wider than your hips.
Push your hips back and let the rope draw your hands between your legs.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips forward and stand tall.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit with your upper back on a bench, a padded bar across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip-width apart, knees bent.
Drive your hips up until your body is level from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
steps: Sit with your upper back on the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip-width apart.
Drive your hips up until your body is level from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Sit against a bench under the Smith bar, with a pad over your hips.
Plant your feet flat and unhook the bar.
Drive your hips up until your body is level from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench, a dumbbell resting on your hips.
Hold the dumbbell in place and plant your feet flat.
Drive your hips up until your body is level from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench, one foot flat, other leg raised.
Push through the planted heel until your body is straight from knee to shoulder.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie face up with your knees bent and heels close to your hips.
Push through your heels and lift your hips into a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg straight out.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips into a straight line.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on the floor with a padded bar across your hips, feet flat.
Hold the bar steady and drive your hips up through your heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly to the floor.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: Strap a cuff to one ankle and attach it to a low pulley.
Face the machine, hold it for support and lean forward slightly.
Kick your leg straight back without arching your lower back.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your set.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
steps: Set up on the machine with one foot against the kick pad.
Hold the handles and push your leg back until your hip is straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Donkey Kick
steps: Get on your hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Keeping the knee bent, lift one foot up towards the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top, lower slowly and switch sides after your set.

name: Fire Hydrant
steps: Get on your hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Keeping the knee bent, lift one leg out to the side to hip height.
Lower slowly without twisting your body, then switch sides.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
steps: Sit on the machine with the pads against the outside of your knees.
Push your knees apart as far as you can.
Pause, then let your legs come back together slowly.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
steps: Sit on the machine with the pads against the inside of your knees.
Squeeze your legs together until the pads meet.
Let your legs open slowly back to the start.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley with the cuff on your far ankle.
Hold the machine for support and lift that leg out to the side.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley with the cuff on your near ankle.
Hold the machine and let the cable pull that leg out slightly.
Sweep the leg inwards and across your body, past your standing foot.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your set.

name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your side with legs straight and your head resting on your arm.
Lift your top leg up, toes pointing forward, without rolling back.
Lower slowly, then switch sides after your set.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
steps: Put a mini band around your legs, just above the knees or ankles.
Stand in a half squat with feet hip-width apart.
Step sideways, keeping the band tight, counting each step as one rep.
Walk the same number of steps back the other way.

name: Clamshell
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and heels together.
Keeping your feet touching, lift your top knee as high as you can.
Lower slowly and switch sides; a band above the knees makes it harder.

name: Copenhagen Plank
steps: Lie on your side next to a bench, propped up on your forearm.
Place your top foot or knee on the bench.
Lift your hips until your body is straight, lower leg off the floor.
Hold, then lower and switch sides.

name: Standing Calf Raise
steps: Stand under the shoulder pads with your heels hanging off the step.
Let your heels drop below the step for a full stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit with the knee pad snug on your thighs, toes on the step's edge.
Release the lock and let your heels drop for a stretch.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can, then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Calf Raise
steps: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause, then lower your heels slowly; stand on a plate for more stretch.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
steps: Stand on a step under the Smith bar, resting it on your upper back.
Unhook the bar and let your heels drop for a stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Hold a dumbbell at each side, heels hanging off a step.
Let your heels drop below the step for a stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can, then lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Stand on one leg on a step, holding a dumbbell on that side.
Hold a rail with your free hand for balance.
Let your heel drop, then rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly, then switch sides after your set.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Bend forward, hold a rail, and stand with your toes on a block.
Load your hips with the machine pad or a partner sitting on them.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the block for a full stretch.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Sit in the leg press, toes on the bottom edge of the plate.
Push the plate up and keep your legs almost straight.
Point your toes to push the plate further, then let it come back slowly.
Use a weight you control so your feet never slip off the edge.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Sit on a bench and set the front of one foot on a block.
Rest a dumbbell on that knee and hold it in place.
Raise your heel as high as you can, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

name: Seated Barbell Calf Raise
steps: Sit on a bench and set the front of both feet on a block.
Rest a padded barbell across your lower thighs and hold it steady.
Raise your heels as high as you can, then lower slowly for a stretch.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
steps: Stand with your heels off a step, one hand on a wall.
Let your heels drop below the step for a stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can, then lower slowly.

name: Box Jump
steps: Stand about a foot away from a sturdy box, feet hip-width apart.
Swing your arms back, dip into a quarter squat and jump onto the box.
Land softly with both feet and knees bent, then stand tall.
Step down rather than jumping down, and reset for the next rep.
